responsibility: Provides the generic ELF subtarget driver and runtime specs for Blackfin bare-metal style environments. It selects startup and end files, libraries, default linker scripts by CPU and SDRAM/multicore variants, user label prefixing, FDPIC-specific CRT call glue, and extra driver self-specs, thereby controlling how the compiler driver links Blackfin ELF programs independently of Linux or uClinux OS-specific overrides.
